title: Tuple decoding of an encoded pair
statement: Let $\mathrm{base}$ and $\mathrm{dec}$ be functions from pairs of bit strings to bit strings. For every natural number $n$ and bit strings $s,w,v$, the level-$(n+1)$ tuple decoding of $\langle w,v\rangle$ with parameter $s$ is $\langle u,\mathrm{dec}(s,v)\rangle$, where $u$ is the level-$n$ tuple decoding of $w$ with parameter $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{base}$ and $\mathrm{dec}$ are functions from pairs of bit strings to bit strings
